scopeReview: CED FUN-4.B.1 introducing optimization through constraints, one-variable objectives, feasible intervals and calculated candidate comparisons. Geometric formulas and units explained. No unrelated discrete optimization or unsupported resource required.
varietyReview: Full-perimeter rectangle, three-side fence, cut-and-fold box, cylinder surface area, sum of squares, squared-distance objective, revenue maximum, infeasible critical input, wire constraint versus objective, proof checklist and two-cost path setup.
repetitionReview: Each prompt and all four options were read separately; distinct tasks/contexts within this set. Cross-topic exact duplicates checked by validator. Semantic similarity and AP difficulty remain judgment calls, not proven by an automated score.
